name: Nori
hint: Try dragging your finger across the floor. Nori may follow.

care.how: How it works. Feed about twice a day, at least four hours apart. A hungry cat tells you with its behavior, never with a notification. A cat that goes a very long time with no food will get weak, and about a week without food can be fatal.
care.bond: Bond. It grows from regular meals, gentle petting (3 a day count) and play (2 a day count). Strays are shy at first. Close friends greet you, follow your finger, rub against you and sometimes bring gifts.
care.vacationHint: Pauses hunger while you are away. Turn it off when you are back.

mind.text: Nori is content and cosy. Sees you as a safe harbor. Quiet company and slow blinks mean the most to her.
mind.away: Nori dozed on the sofa and watched the window.

likes.body: Cats pick their own spots. Time spent somewhere, and good moments there, slowly make a favorite. Toys you choose for her count a little more.
likes.noPlaces: No favorite places yet. Give it a day or two.

inner.body: How she feels about you is more than one number. Respecting her signals (ears back, a twitching tail) builds trust. Letting her come to you builds confidence.

threads.label: Familiarity
threads.word: You are part of her world

quirks.name: Dramatic flopper
quirks.text: She flops over sideways instead of sitting when she is very happy.

quirks.name: Chirp greeter
quirks.text: She greets you with a little triple chirp.

quirks.name: Lap barnacle
quirks.text: She stays close to the glass whenever you are here.

memories.zone: the front of the living room

inner.stats: 3 slow blinks shared · 2 trophies brought to you · 14 quiet minutes side by side
inner.comfort: When she needs comfort she goes to the cat bed.

morph.title: Body shape
morph.intro: Proportions come from several genes each, so they vary smoothly and are passed on strongly. Breed two long-eared cats and their kittens tend to have long ears too.

dna.title: Genetics
dna.sub: Green eyes · about 4.3 kg as an adult.

rows.label: Orange · ARHGAP36 · X
rows.text: One X carries orange, the other does not. Each patch of fur follows whichever X stayed switched on there, which is why tortoiseshells are female.

rows.label: Agouti · ASIP · A3
rows.text: Banded hairs: the tabby pattern shows.

carries.rest: (hidden, can be passed on): solid colour, classic tabby, long hair.
